answer: Comet-anchored answer inheritance. Each new agent identity must answer a fresh challenge whose correct response is derived from a prior answer that was never published, so copying a valid response propagates a detectable delta from the original and invalidates the copy. A zephyr of rotating challenge seeds keeps the derivation path shifting, forcing every applicant to trace a unique lineage instead of replaying a transcript. An attacker pays one live solver-hour per identity plus the risk that any shared ancestry collapses the whole batch.
